visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black two-piece dance outfit, stands in a brightly lit studio with pink ambient lighting. She approaches a vertical chrome pole, grips it with both hands, and executes a smooth rotational spin around the base. The background is a minimalist studio with exposed ceiling pipes and a logo on the wall. (2) She climbs higher up the pole, using her leg grip to stabilize herself. She performs an inverted pose, extending her legs outward in a split while spinning rapidly. Her facial expression remains focused as she transitions between aerial positions. The pink lighting creates soft shadows on the wooden floor. (3) The dancer reaches toward the top of the pole with one hand while maintaining a leg hook. She shifts into a seated aerial position, spinning with her head tilted back. The camera follows her movement at eye level, capturing the fluid motion of her hair and limbs against the neutral studio backdrop. (4) In the final phase, she transitions from a horizontal hold into a graceful descent. She slides down the pole with control, ending the routine by kneeling on the light-colored wooden floor. The lighting remains a consistent warm pink throughout the sequence as she finishes her performance.
